ad.audience: Women in the US who love soft linen basics and small-made everyday clothes.
ad.creative: Put money behind on-hand fall drop photos that already get the most love. They show fit and soft movement best, so start small and keep only what feels calm.

weeks.do: Post a Reels try-on in soft daylight showing the fall linen set in motion. Share a feed photo of the same set worn on hand and ask a Threads question about which earthy color to bring back.
weeks.post_idea: You in the oat linen shirt and stone wide pants by a bright window, holding the hem to show drape, with a pine sprig and wood stool nearby.

weeks.do: Post a Reels close-up that opens with fabric near the camera then steps back to show the full look. Share a calm feed flat photo styled with the look worn on hand.
weeks.post_idea: Close-up of your hand smoothing the clay cotton tee tucked into sand linen pants on your porch, morning light on the weave.

weeks.do: Post a Reels try-on mixing fall drop tops and bottoms for everyday wear. Ask a Threads question about linen care with a worn on-hand photo.
weeks.post_idea: You wearing the moss linen overshirt over the cream cotton tank and oatmeal drawstring shorts in your kitchen, holding a warm mug.

weeks.do: Share a feed photo of the fall look that got the most love. Post a Reels slow turn in that same look and ask a Threads follow-up about restock colors.
